v2.name: Name
v2.archiveHelp: Archiving stops admission and disables producers. Source and history are retained.
v2.unarchiveHelp: Tasks and schedules remain disabled until you enable them explicitly.
v2.deleteHelp: Reclaims source after ownership and preservation checks. Historical identities remain.
v2.confirmName: Type the workspace name to confirm
v2.argumentsExactHelp: Each field is one argument. Empty values, whitespace and line breaks are preserved. Remove a field to remove that argument.
v2.readinessHelp: Readiness checks resources without running, building, syncing or injecting files.
v2.managedOnly: Select a managed environment with a ready build.
v2.dashboardHelp: Source, execution and recovery status from your current instance.
v2.loginHelp: Sign in to manage your workspaces and automation.
v2.setupHelp: Set up the administrator for this new instance.
v2.notReady: The instance is recovering. Some actions are temporarily unavailable.
v2.localHelp: A managed folder for your scripts. No Git repository is required.
v2.gitHelp: An independent checkout of a repository branch, tag or commit.
v2.fixedRef: Tags and commits remain pinned to the original resolved commit.
v2.dirtyNotice: Local changes are preserved. Resolve them explicitly before syncing.
v2.previewHelp: Preview is read-only. Review every action before applying.
v2.previewExpired: Preview changed or expired. Generate a new preview.
v2.deadReadOnly: Exhausted events are read-only under the current contract.
v2.discardHelp: Your unsaved draft is kept only in this page.
v2.fileConflict: The file changed on disk. Your draft has been kept.
v2.fileConflictHelp: Reload only after reviewing or copying your draft. Saving again will not overwrite the newer version.
v2.fileGuard: This file cannot be edited safely. Check file type, size and workspace state.
v2.selectFile: Select a file to start editing
v2.runtimeCatalogEmpty: The version catalog is empty. Refresh it first.
v2.runtimeInstallationRequired: No language runtime is installed and ready. Install Python or Node.js before creating a managed environment.
v2.restoreHelp: Restore validates a candidate before publishing. Existing unknown roots are never overwritten.
v2.restoreConfirm: Type RESTORE to stage this validated candidate
v2.restartRequired: A controlled application restart may be required to finish restore.
v2.sessionHelp: Management actions require an authenticated session and request protection.
v2.error.generic: The request could not be completed. Review the diagnostic and retry when appropriate.
v2.error.network: The server could not be reached. Your unsaved changes are retained.
v2.error.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue.
v2.error.forbidden: Your session is not authorized for this action.
v2.error.conflict: This resource changed. Reload its latest version and review your changes before saving.
v2.error.busy: A running operation owns this workspace. Wait for it to finish before retrying.
v2.error.recovery: Recovery must finish before source access or new execution can continue.
v2.error.preview: The discovery preview is stale. Generate and review a new preview.
v2.error.dirty: Local or staged changes block synchronization. Your source is preserved.
v2.error.diverged: Local commits differ from the remote history. Review them explicitly; automatic merging is disabled.
v2.error.unsafeTree: This Git tree contains unsafe paths or case/Unicode aliases and cannot be checked out safely.
v2.error.superseded: Source or resources changed before execution. This run was skipped; it did not run the latest source.
v2.logsTruncated: Output is bounded. Use the next page to read more.
v2.webhookSecretOnce: Copy this webhook secret now. It is shown only once.
v2.configImmutableHelp: Config content is stored as immutable revisions. Bind an asset to a workspace or task to materialize it for execution.
v2.confirmSecretDelete: Confirm removal of this channel’s saved credentials
v2.envPrecedence: Effective values: global → selected workspace profile → task overrides. Unset removes an inherited name.
v2.repositoryHelp: Repositories store Git sources and credentials. Each Git workspace has its own independent checkout and execution settings.
v2.secretWriteOnly: Secret content is write-only. Enter a complete replacement to create a revision.
v2.sessionMemory: Session credentials remain in memory. Reloading this page requires signing in again.
v2.storageHelp: Storage admission is verified by the server. Existing preservation holds are retained until they can be reclaimed safely.
v2.twoFactorLoginHelp: Enter your six-digit code if two-factor authentication is enabled.
v2.twoFactorRequired: Password verified. Enter the code from your authenticator to continue.
v2.confirmTwoFactorDisable: Disable two-factor authentication and sign out all sessions?
v2.twoFactorSecretHelp: Scan this code with your authenticator, then enter its current code. Keep the setup key private.
v2.sessionsRevoked: Saving these credentials signs out all sessions. Sign in with the new credentials.
v2.v2BackendRequired: This interface requires the isolated v2 application. Connect to a v2 backend before signing in.
v2.syncResolutionHelp: Local and remote history differ. Automatic sync is blocked and local files are preserved. Review commits before choosing a resolution.
v2.syncRemoteCopy: Back up and create remote copy
v2.syncKeepHelp: The blocked warning remains. Existing tasks keep using local code; this does not mean remote updates succeeded.
v2.syncRemoteHelp: Create a full backup, then a new Git workspace from the current branch. Existing files and task bindings are preserved. Verify the copy before switching tasks manually.
v2.syncManualHelp: Create a full backup, then export it with a passphrase in Settings → Backup and restore. Compare and merge commits in an independent Git checkout. Keep the original workspace until verified, then switch tasks. Do not run reset --hard in managed directories.
v2.syncExportBackup: Open Settings → Backup and restore to export this backup
v2.syncCopyConfirm: I confirm a new workspace will be created; I will verify it and switch tasks manually. Original files and task bindings are preserved.
v2.syncTaskSwitchHelp: Wait for the new workspace to become ready, verify files and runtime settings, then select it in each task editor. This wizard does not migrate or duplicate scheduled tasks.
v2.proxyPlatformHelp: The platform defaults to a direct connection. Shared runtime installation and operations without a workspace inherit this setting.
v2.proxyScopeHelp: Inherit the parent setting, select a proxy, or force a direct connection. Changes apply to future operations; running tasks retain their configuration.
v2.proxySshHelp: Git HTTPS supports proxies. Git SSH proxying is not supported; selecting a proxy returns an explicit error instead of silently connecting directly.
v2.proxyPasswordHelp: Passwords are never returned. Leave Replace secret unchecked to keep the existing password.
v2.proxyUnavailable: The selected or inherited proxy is unavailable. Choose another profile or a direct connection.
v2.proxySocksHelp: pip requires PySocks in the target Python environment for SOCKS5. Missing support returns an explicit error. Prefer HTTP/HTTPS proxies for ordinary pip installation.
v2.proxyDeleteReferenced: This proxy is referenced by configuration. Change those references before deleting it.
v2.proxyErrorInUse: This proxy is still referenced. Change those references before deleting it.
v2.proxyErrorDisabled: This proxy is disabled. Enable it or select another proxy/direct connection.
v2.proxyErrorNotFound: This proxy no longer exists. Select another proxy or a direct connection.
v2.proxyErrorSsh: Git SSH proxying is not supported. Use Git HTTPS or explicitly select a direct connection.
v2.proxyErrorSocks: This Python environment lacks SOCKS support (PySocks). Install PySocks first or use an HTTP/HTTPS proxy.
v2.historyBoundaryHelp: Select local times; queries include the start and exclude the end. Records not yet started use submission time.
v2.cleanupConfirmHelp: Only finished, unused data can be removed. Deletion cannot be undone; review the estimated count first.
v2.cleanupHasMore: Cleanup is batched. Scan and confirm another batch if more eligible data remains.
v2.maintenanceHelp: Only explicitly managed ZhiXu data is scanned and cleaned. Active tasks, installed runtimes, dependency environments, workspaces, repositories, credentials and backups are preserved. Ambiguous data is skipped.
v2.maintenanceDaily: Automatic cleanup runs once a day. Manual scans use the current retention policy.
v2.maintenanceAutomaticFailed: The latest automatic cleanup did not complete fully. Review the error and retry.
v2.maintenanceUsagePartial: Partial scan; some data is not included
v2.backupFullHelp: Saves local data and Git code completely. Larger backups are suited to important backups and offline recovery of data already present locally.
v2.backupLightweightHelp: Saves local changes and necessary Git metadata. Restoring Git workspaces requires the original remote repository and its base objects; if unavailable, use a FULL backup.
v2.backupRecoveryRemote: Original Git remote, required objects and valid credentials / proxy
v2.backupRecoveryLocal: Restore the local data included in this backup; managed runtimes need rebuilding
v2.backupFullLfsWarning: Git LFS configuration was detected. This backup preserves locally downloaded LFS data; check whether external objects that were never downloaded need a separate backup.
v2.backupFullSubmoduleWarning: Git submodule configuration was detected. Check that required submodule files and objects are present locally; external data that was never downloaded needs a separate backup.
